scope: Additional distinct public municipal QPR reporting quarters, independently indexed by HUD; exact published F31 activity identifiers plus separately labeled QPR-only NYC administrative/planning IDs, with no inferred crosswalk. These are report-vintage period and to-date values, not an exhaustive set of activities, not F31 flows and not beneficiary-city allocations. Do not add QPR snapshots to F31 or add to-date values across quarters.

method.acquisition: Remaining distinct HUD directRecipient-indexed public municipal report versions. Existing sample and milestone reports are not added to this batch; neither search nor index is exhaustive.
method.validation: 236 approved report identities and 236 whole-grant tables checked independently. 196 award headers were verified; 40 report versions do not expose a verified award header and remain blank. All accepted activity financial cells were coordinate anchored; 754 stratified activity records were independently checked.
method.reconciliation: 1718 exact F31 activity-quarter pairs agree for both period expenditure and obligation; 1 differ and 0 contain unavailable F31 cells. Differences remain visible with exact signed deltas and source snapshots; no silent replacement.
method.scope: Administering government is not beneficiary geography. QPR activity listings can omit activities; no local money or activity locations are inferred. To-date snapshots must not be added across periods or to F31 flows.
method.transformer: Offline MiniLM retrieval on 240 documents and 11964 nonblank pages; 720 document-scoped queries. Similarity is a search lead, not source verification or a completeness guarantee.
